Gameplay is fine, and the gacha system is pretty standard for a HoYo game.

But the game's art direction has gone from peak to just "meh."

There's no longer that unique blend of cyberpunk and late-'80s aesthetics in either the world or the character designs. It feels like the game has lost its distinctive style.

Just look at Yi Xuan, Lucia, Yidhari, and now Sunbringer. They all look way too similar.

The factions have become boring too. Most of them just look like random guys and girls from Genshin. We don't get stylish, memorable factions like Belobog or Victoria anymore.

The game is still good overall, but its identity is gone.

Between the PS5, Epic, and the Steam beta, I have over 1,000+ hours in this game.

The combat feels great, the character designs are top notch, and the soundtrack is easily one of the best parts. Even with the usual gacha grind and RNG frustration, it's just a really fun loop that keeps you coming back. I didn't think it would come to Steam this early, but I'm glad it did. Highly recommend giving it a try.

Zenless is one of the best games I've ever played. The strongest point is the combat and its parry system, it's quite fun and the combat feels very satisfactory, specially later on as you learn the intricate mechanics.
The place where I have most fun it's the endgame mode, I always try for hours to get a high score, despite no extra rewards for it, just for the fun of it.

Be aware, this is a gacha game, and as every gacha game the monetization model can feel a bit aggresive, so unless you spend money, you might not be able to get every character you want, but neither you need to.

You can beat everything the game offers with limited choices as long as you learn and execute the team rotations correctly. This is not a pay to win game, since good skill can get you even more than double the score of the average player.
The game's skill ceiling can reach very high for certain characters, mastering the mechanics and character rotation for a team can be very challenging but also extremely rewarding.

The character designs are amazing and the music slaps too, so definitely give it a try!

I've been playing this game since its release day in 1.0, has quickly become one of my favorite games of all time despite being a Gacha, which is never pleasing for anybody, but admittedly I'm pretty deep in the genre.

Unmatched combat, aesthetic, funny and endearing characters, by far Hoyo's best in my opinion. According to HoyoLab, I'm 710 days and counting into this game and not once has it felt like a chore to log in and do my dailies, since this game might have the freest and quickest daily system of all time. A few clicks and you can be out for the day if you really want to.

While Season 2 has been mixed for many reasons, Season 3 so far seems to deliver on being a better follow up to the aesthetic and setting presented in Season 1 and improving in many aspects. I cannot recommend this game enough if you like your games to have some sauce, and a combat that is satisfying to no end. 

Give it a shot!
